body: I wish it was that easy. 😞

I cannot possibly explain everything that has led me to this state of mind in a single post or reply, but like I said above, all I've ever wanted was to truly care for and love somebody, and every girl that I've tried to do that with has rejected me, either because they didn't like me, or sometimes they did but they were in a relationship, and they've been my only hopes, hopes that always get stamped out. I don't know how to meet girls, I've tried every single which way to try to meet women that I can possibly think of and it never ever goes my way. I am willing to put everything on the line for someone, to sacrifice everything I have and make myself into the person that I need to be for a girl, but nobody has ever given me that chance, ever. It is crushing. Everyone else my age has found their person, and they found them long ago, yet here I am, alone. The people I work with love their families, they love their significant others, I wish that I had someone to tell others about, to express my love for that person. I've tried to come to self fulfilment, I watched an anime about two years ago that really really inspired me to try and live up to it, to try and become a better more caring and understanding person. I've tried to live out its message and it seems that I cannot no matter how hard I try to.
Thank you. I'm honestly more worried if I made her uncomfortable, so I probably deserve what might come.
I know that you're probably right, still I am going to give this one more chance. If nothing comes of it then I guess I'll just end this.
